name: plans
description: Run an approved list of steps overnight on the worker. Start a plan with action submit, check one with action status.

action.description: submit starts a plan. status checks one plan by plan_id.

plan_id.description: The plan to check. Used with action status.

steps.description: Used with action submit. Each step: skill, action, args, optional continue_on_failure and idempotent.

max_hours.description: Used with action submit. Time budget in hours. The plan pauses when it runs out.

approval_id.description: Used with action submit when a step changes something outside the sandbox: the code from 'approve <code>'.
